name: Barbarian Marked Rager
body:
Marked ragers form a connection with the spirits of the desert and channel their essence, gaining the ability to perform great feats.

A marked rager has the following class features.

Spirit-Mark (Ex)

At 3rd level, marked ragers can create their first spirit-mark in a one hour ritual under the light of the moon that involves meditation and communing with the spirit they wish to emulate. Marked ragers can inscribe a spirit-mark in one of two ways. They can cut their body (dealing 1 hp damage which automatically heals at dawn) and rub sand or dirt into it, creating a permanent scar, or they can make a sacrificial burnt offering of incense and use the ashes to create a permanent tattoo on their body. Marked ragers gain their second spirit-mark at 9th level, and their third spirit-mark at 15th level.

The details for each spirit-mark are detailed below.

This replaces all iterations of the barbarian’s trap sense.

Spirit Mark Benefits
Camel

Spitting Mad: As a swift action, you can regurgitate the contents of your stomach, spitting the unpleasant mash at a single target within 5 feet. The target must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your barbarian level + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, the target is sickened 1d4 rounds. You can use this spirit-mark a number of times per day equal to 1/2 your barbarian level. cheetah Sprinter: You can move at 5 times your normal speed while running as long as you aren’t wearing heavy armor and you aren’t carrying a heavy load. You can use this spirit-mark a number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier.

Coyote, hyena, jackal, or wild dog

Scent: You gain the monster ability scent.

Ant

Ant Anatomy: When you create this spiritmark, choose one of the following benefits: you gain a 20-foot climb speed or a +2 bonus on mind-affecting saving throws Or you are constantly under the effects of ant haul. This choice is permanent and can’t be changed.

Horned lizard

Bloody Assault: You can squirt a 5-foot long stream of caustic blood from your eyes as a swift action. A targeted creature can make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your barbarian level + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, a creature is blinded for 1 round and sickened for 1d2 rounds. You can use this spirit-mark a number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier.

Jerboa

Bonus Feat: You gain Improved Initiative as a bonus feat.

Desert hedgehog

Prickly Defense: When a creature is about to make a melee attack against you, you can use an immediate action to grow spines that last until the start of your next turn, granting a +1 enhancement bonus to your natural AC. You can use this spiritmark a number of times per day equal to 1/2 your barbarian level.

Goat

Bonus Feat: You gain Nimble Moves as a bonus feat.

Desert cottontail

Elude Predator: Your base speed increases by 10 feet.

Lion

Bonus Feat: You gain Run as a bonus feat.

Meerkat

Mobber: Whenever you and an adjacent ally threaten the same creature, you gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against that creature.

Scorpion

Tremorsense: You gain tremorsense with a 15-foot range.

Tortoise

Bonus Feat: You gain Endurance as a bonus feat.

Snake

Snake Anatomy: When you create this spirit-mark, choose one of the following benefits: you gain a 30-foot swim speed Or a +2 bonus on saving throws against injury poisons Or once per day when you are at less than half your hit points, as a standard action that provokes an attack of opportunity, you can molt. When you molt, your old skin sloughs off and you form a new skin. This process restores 1/2 of your missing hit points. This choice is permanent and can’t be changed.

Vulture

Bonus Feat: You gain Great Fortitude as a bonus feat.
